page.layout: Two columns of running text on one printed page, with marginal notes in the left margin and right margin, and a few notes below the text. Reading order: the page head at top (page number 380 and running head), then the main text column from top to bottom, then the left margin notes beside it, then the right margin notes.

main_text.p: Homines natura cedentibus imperare, invadentes cave folent. lib. 4.

Alio quodam fenfu contemptu quis tutus, clariori-bus viris impune infectando negotium faceffit. Hæ-texius invifior fuit, quia fomno aut libidinofis vigiliis marcidus, & ob fegnitiam quamvis crudelem princi-pem non metuens, illufribus viris perniciem interga-neum ac ftupra meditabatur. Principes enim potentiæ retinendæ anxii, hoc genus mortalium, ut factioni-bus cogendis minus idoneum, negligentia tramittunt.

Quod fit bonum viri officium, quem modo laudavi Thu-cydidem audiamus. ὃς αἰτίως τοῖς ἀρχαῖς ἢ ἔχει δὲ ... nam qui paribus qui-dem non cedunt, ergo superiores autem honestè se ge-runt, & ergo inferiores moderatè; iis res maximè pro-spere cedant. libro v. Quas graviffimi autoris fenten-tias, etsi de bellico conflictu prolatas, jure quodam meo ad togæ difceptationes detorfi.
main_text.head: IV. Compendiofa parando odio via, judicandi feveritas.
main_text.p: Quæ nec fine multorum offenfione fit, nec offen-fio fine animorum averfione. Cotta Meffalinus favi-fima cujusque fententia autor, eoque inveteratain vi-dia. Hos ob metum plerique fimulato honore co-lunt, iis via decedunt, hos amicos habere, fficto magis quam fyncero voto, exoptant. Aft ubi primula lapfas eorum rima, ubi offenfi domini fufpicio, paffim in eos infurgitur. ubi primùm facultas data, arguitur. fed properanter Meffalinus arguitur. objecta enim crimi-na nullum Tiberii odium, amicitiæ potiùs fiduciam, infimulant. C. Cafarem quafi incefta virilitatis, dixiffe, quem & Tiberius oderat, nec nifi odio Romanorum & fenatus fucceffurem voluerat. facerdotales epulas novendialem cœnam dixiffe arguebatur. qui fine no-candi ftudio jocus liberalior erat. page.notes: Left margin: "Contempta mordax." and "Boni viri cancelli." Printed in small italic type beside the text; "Scueri judices" is a marginal catchword near the lower left. Greek passage (Thucydides) is only partly legible: the phrase after "αἰτίως" and "ἔχει" is uncertain and marked by ellipsis here, which is a fault; these Greek words should be copied letter by letter from the scan and were not reliably read. Several lines of the main text in the middle and right columns are uncertain and are not marked with [?] throughout because the scan is faint; treat the transcription of the lower half as doubtful. Heading "IV." set in larger type is a numbered section; the title "Compendiosa parando odio via, judicandi feveritas" is its level-2 heading.
